events.text_en: On the frost coast, the digger Thiệu Tàn Đăng forces the sealed fire hall of Băng Hỏa Môn with a borrowed fire talisman. The hall's ward burns him in the doorway, and his lamp goes out.
Tề Đoản Vĩ, chief of the robbers of the Bobtail ridge for a century, dies under a Thúy Vi road patrol's swords on the Thạch Công road. His foundling Khấu Thiên Tứ buries him and takes the band.
A sandstorm out of Phong Sa Nhãn buries a salt caravan on the desert road. One guard walks out of it, carrying the other's sabre.
Two hunters of Lãnh Nguyệt Lâm dig a wolf-king's cub out of its den in Quần Lang Lâm and sell it at Quy Điểu's ice market to a buyer riding south with a Pivot caravan.
Diggers open the frozen doors of Bắc Minh Quán on the northern shore, empty since 332. The ice-cutters they hired could not chip one door; a girl of Tạc Băng Thôn melted it with her hands.
